changes.note: Instrument switched from official bank rate to Central Bank target, overnight rate, per BIS's own era text.

coverage.note: Derived entirely from BIS daily policy-rate levels (WS_CBPOL); every day the level differs from the prior day is a change day. Instrument eras parsed from the BIS COMPILATION field (2 era(s)).

sources.label: BIS central bank policy rates (CBPOL), Canada
